name: orchestrator
description: Business banking orchestrator for direct specialist routing, A2UI draft plan review, structured plan editing, approval, rejection, and final result retrieval.

skills.name: Submit orchestrator request
skills.description: Submit a relationship-manager request for direct specialist routing or complex draft-plan creation.
examples: Prepare me for tomorrow's meeting with ABC Manufacturing.

skills.name: Review A2UI plan
skills.description: Review structured draft plan JSON and A2UI approval-plan parts before specialist graph execution.

skills.name: Edit orchestrator plan
skills.description: Apply discrete draft-plan edits through add instruction, remove step, replace agent, or reorder step tools without graph execution.

skills.name: Approve orchestrator plan
skills.description: Approve a draft only with matching plan identity, approval surface, edited version, and approved step IDs, then execute the graph.

skills.name: Reject orchestrator plan
skills.description: Reject a pending draft plan with a structured reason and complete without graph execution or specialist calls.
